name: Silfade Kenbunroku
source:
The story revolves around Eshutā, who wishes to be a doctor. He managed to enter the renowned Nōma Academy, and then he starts an extraordinary school life, in which he is surrounded by weird characters and peculiar events thanks to his misfortune and hard luck...

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silfade_Kembunroku]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕立志成为医生的艾修塔展开。他成功进入著名的诺玛学院，却因时运不济，被各种怪人和离奇事件包围，就此开始一段非同寻常的校园生活……

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silfade_Kembunroku]Wikipedia[/url]]
